slug: 2025-09-18 Ethiopia's approach to their National Data Strategy offers lessons for Africa's digital future

facts.fact: DIAL writes that in 2025 Ethiopia was wrapping up its current Digital Transformation Strategy and was on the cusp of introducing Digital Ethiopia 2030, with preparation underway; the piece gives no more precise date, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: Office of the Prime Minister, with a technical committee of INSA, the Ministry of Innovation and Technology, the Ethiopian AI Institute and Addis Ababa University
